summary: Iteration-2 verification of the 4 follow-up tasks on the plan-reader layer. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_real_plans.py (19 cases, 17 pass) exercised all 5 REAL sanctioned drawings through /api/plan/extract plus real placement on digigov.pdf. All 5 files return HTTP 200 with extractionPath=vector_text (kasturba 2.1s, sot 2.3s, almakka 9.2s, digigov 17.5s, hotel 23.0s). digigov Type-1/2/3 all found, planReference is CLEAN (odps_inward_no ODPS/2025/120600, scale 1:200, zero alphabetic garbage), prefill plotArea 2229.75 / builtUp 1777.36 / F-1 correct, 3 floor blocks at 1:200. Real placement on digigov: available=true, bboxPx covers only 10.7% of the page (tight), sprinkler markers capped at exactly 250 (of ~510), overlayNote explains subsample + engine building-wide total (228), and the call returned in 0.26s (cache hit) — all 4 placement claims confirmed. Frontend: CONFIRM FLOW IS REPAIRED (/confirm?manual=true -> /api/analyze-mixed 200 -> valid /results report, no console errors, previously 400). FIT-TO-BLOCK works: upload digigov -> review -> results shows report-plan-reference / report-equipment-quantities / report-equipment-placement, plan-viewer auto-zoomed (scale 1.594 with a pan offset, not scale 1), and viewer-fit-block / viewer-reset / viewer-zoom-in / viewer-zoom-out all change the transform; placement-overlay-note, placement-side-table, placement-legend all present. Manual-entry regression clean (A-4/20m/3 floors -> standard report, none of the 3 plan-only sections, analyze-mixed 200). 2 real-file claims did not hold (almakka calibrationSource, kasturba floor block) and a REGRESSION was found in block geometry detection for sparse plans.

critical.issue: REGRESSION vs iteration_1: the synthetic fixture (_synthetic_plan.pdf) now returns geometryAvailable=false and placement returns available=false ('No floor-plan block with usable vector line geometry'). Root cause is the new percentile-trimmed _block_bbox_around() in plan_reader/scale_detector.py: it now uses the 8th-92nd percentile of segment MIDPOINTS, which on sparse-geometry blocks collapses the bbox so _bbox_has_geometry() counts <4 segments. It also produces a DEGENERATE zero-area bbox (e.g. block-1 bbox [560.0,397.5,560.0,397.5]) when region_lines has only 1-2 members. Fix: keep the percentile trim only when len(region_lines) is large (e.g. >=20), otherwise fall back to the full min/max bbox, and always enforce a minimum box size.

STILL BROKEN (pre-existing engine bug, now unused by /confirm): any valid BuildingInput returns 400 'Invalid input...' (real cause AttributeError on nbc_compliance=None in engines/standards_engine.py, swallowed by the broad except in routes/analyze_manual.py). Either fix the guard or remove/deprecate the endpoint so it does not mislead API consumers.

minor.issue: CLAIM NOT MET: kasturba.pdf yields ZERO floor-plan blocks — the only block detected is 'Key Plan' (isFloorPlan=false), geometryAvailable=false, and placement is unavailable. _choose_floor_page_by_text picks page index 1 of 5, which apparently has no floor-plan title anchor. Consider scanning all pages for a floor-plan anchor / picking the page with the most geometry.

CLAIM PARTIALLY MET: floor blocks DO have unit 'ft' (unitSource explicit_note) and nts=true, but calibrationSource is 'unresolved (N.T.S. and no dimension text)', NOT 'dimension_only'. dimension_only appears only on the non-floor blocks (Key Plan, Parking). Net effect is honest degradation (placement correctly unavailable, column labels like C5 12"X27" are not misread) but the stated dimension_only-on-a-floor-block behaviour does not occur. Also almakka's two 'Ground Floor' blocks have hasGeometry=false with a degenerate full-width bbox [0,3206,826,3370] — same percentile-bbox defect as above.
planReference is null for kasturba, sot, hotel and almakka (Type-3 not found). Only digigov produces it. Acceptable/honest, but worth confirming these sheets genuinely lack the metadata block.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid on any confirm-page control (Building Name, Building Type, all number inputs, 'Confirm & Analyze', 'Back'). Had to fall back to placeholder/role selectors, which is brittle for regression tests.

issues: Fit-to-block pan is not clamped to the image bounds: after auto-zoom (translate(-434px,-37px) scale(1.594)) roughly 20% of the viewer on the right is empty dark background while the sheet is clipped on the left, so the block is not centred. Clamp the translate so the scaled image always fills the viewport.
Auto-zoom factor is only 1.59x for a block that occupies 10.7% of the sheet, so markers are still small; consider scaling to the block bbox (with padding) rather than a fixed-ish factor.
The 'Drag to pan · +/- to zoom' hint strip sits on top of the drawing at the bottom edge with low-contrast grey text over the plan.
Report title falls back to 'Mixed-Occupancy Building' even when occupancy mode is SINGLE (A-4) and project name is blank — misleading label; use 'Untitled Building' or the occupancy code.

action_items: Fix the percentile bbox regression in plan_reader/scale_detector.py _block_bbox_around(): fall back to full min/max bbox when region_lines is small, never emit a zero-area bbox. This currently disables placement on sparse-geometry plans (synthetic fixture, almakka ground-floor blocks).
Improve floor-page/block selection so kasturba.pdf produces a floor-plan block (currently only 'Key Plan' -> placement unavailable).
Either fix or deprecate /api/analyze-manual (still 400 on every valid payload); the broad except in routes/analyze_manual.py masks the real AttributeError.
Clamp the PlanViewer fit-to-block transform to image bounds (dead space on the right + left clipping) and increase the block-fit zoom.
Add data-testid attributes to all controls on frontend/src/app/confirm/page.tsx.
Rename the default report title when occupancy mode is SINGLE (currently 'Mixed-Occupancy Building').
critical_code_review_comments: routes/plan.py:148 reads doc.converted_from AFTER doc.close() (line 142) — read every needed attribute before closing; this is fragile and will break if converted_from ever becomes a property backed by the open document.
plan_reader/scale_detector.py _block_bbox_around(): percentile indexing with int(p*(n-1)) degenerates for n<=3 (all percentiles equal), producing zero-area bboxes; guard on len(region_lines).
routes/analyze_manual.py: bare `except` converted to 400 hides 500-class engine bugs — log/re-raise or return 500 with the exception class.
plan_reader/store.py is an in-memory dict with no TTL/size cap; extract caches the full page image + bytes per upload, so memory grows unbounded per session on 6740x4768 renders.

rca_of_the_issue: Geometry regression: the iteration-2 change to plan_reader/scale_detector.py:_block_bbox_around replaced the full min/max bbox of region line segments with an 8th-92nd percentile box over segment MIDPOINTS. On dense CAD sheets (digigov) this correctly tightens the box to 10.7% of the page, but on sparse blocks it shrinks/collapses the box: with only 1-3 segments every percentile resolves to the same value, yielding a zero-area bbox, and _bbox_has_geometry (which requires >=4 midpoints inside the box with length>3) then returns False. Reproduce: POST /app/backend/tests/_synthetic_plan.pdf to /api/plan/extract -> geometryAvailable=false, block-1 bbox [560.0,397.5,560.0,397.5]; then POST /api/plan/placement with that planId -> available=false. Mitigation: only apply the percentile trim when len(region_lines) >= ~20 and clamp the resulting box to a minimum span (else use min/max of segment endpoints).
